geometry.note: No checks[] row: the 71-station sd750 flag and the collaboration's own quoted '61-detector, 23.5 km2' infill figure do not obviously describe the same set (see method); asserting a check against a figure that may not match this shape would be dishonest, not merely imprecise.

method: Convex hull of the 71 stations flagged sd750=1 in sdMap.csv (49 sd750-only + 22 dual-flagged sd1500/sd750), same UTM-to-WGS84 conversion and hull algorithm as geometry:auger-sd1500-array-boundary. Computed area is 29.3 km^2, 24.7% above the 23.5 km^2 figure quoted for the '61-detector infilled array' in a 2026 collaboration paper (src:cosmic-gamma-ta-arxiv-2026-recent-findings is the wrong facility -- see notes for the actual infill source used); the 71-station sd750 flag count itself does not match the quoted 61-detector figure, so this is very likely a different (looser) definition of 'infill station' than the one behind the quoted 23.5 km^2 number. No checks[] row is asserted for this reason -- see worklog residual.
name: Pierre Auger Observatory infill surface-detector array (750 m spacing), convex hull
notes: Area (29.3 km^2) does not match the collaboration's own quoted '23.5 km^2, 61-detector' infill figure closely enough to assert a checks[] row; the sd750 flag likely covers a superset (e.g. including AMIGA/HEAT-related stations) of the specific infill array that figure describes. Flagged as backlog.
Licence added 2026-10-25: sdMap.csv is released under CC BY-SA 4.0 (opendata.auger.org home page), so the derived geometry carries that licence name and attribution.

summary.plain: A smaller, more closely packed patch of detector tanks near the centre of the Auger array, added to catch lower-energy cosmic rays.
